storyLines: Then why don't you join our club?
It's a soccer club a..and we're really good at it..!
Everyone's working hard, but we're low on numbers.
How many do we have? Probably 3 ... including you?
If you really want... you could join another club...
Do not make them pay attention to you...
^<font=CROOKED>^...ARE YOU ALSO JOINING THE TENNIS CLUB?
^<font=CROOKED>^WE'LL BE GOOD TO YOU, I PROMISE!
(He stopped talking with a sobbing sound.)
